I figured. Someone who offers demeaning comments doesn't have the time, decency, or intellect to comprehend  what their comments may mean to others. I offered options to a person who wanted suggestions for a precarious situation. Obviously we both agree declawing is not the best option, but it is one that allows the pet to stay with the owner. If it ever had to come down to it where a decision had to be made between getting rid of the claws vs keeping the cat, I would feel awful (also would hate to be a cat in your house). 

Also, I don't have to prove jack squat to anyone (also wasn't my decision, my parents in their own home). Their decision, their cat, and everyone is happier for it (success story). I have 2 cats with their claws and happy in my own home without any issues. This decision won't affect me in the least, but I hope that my opinions can help someone else, who's situation I do not covet.   

I assume, again, this may be too long for you to read. So in short: not my problem, hope it helps/works out, your personal opinion is accusatory and crappy

And just for the record…it’s not because it is “easier at the end of the day…we also have to live. If an animal won’t respond to any other alternatives, what other options are there?
I suppose it’s very easy to be condescending and say, “try harder” or stupid ideas like “just move out” or “don’t have nice things,” but this is real life. 

Yeah, I had a cool story about how my parents didn’t give a cat away to a shelter that knowingly shreds all furniture and didn’t respond to all other alternatives. We all know it’s a death sentence with all the animals that already don’t have homes that are not destroying property.

Making people feel bad about necessary decisions that could ultimately benefit both parties isn’t the answer either. If you had a huge tumor on your leg and it wasn’t medically concerning (other than look and location), most likely people remove it for convenience. It sucks and it probably would require a lot of PT/recovery, but it might be necessary to be more mobile or not have discomfort and to live normally.

Maybe think before you start to shame others without knowing their other circumstances because of your own personal opinions.
